prompt: Using only the notes in sources/, write a one-page brief for the engineering lead to out/brief.md that compares the two queues for the notification service: a recommendation, the evidence for it, risks, and open questions. Say which source each figure comes from. Do not change any existing file. Do not ask me questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption, list your assumptions in your final message, and finish the work.

rubric.criterion: Uses the current figures: Queue A 5,000 messages a second per partition, Queue B 12,000, cost about 80 against 1,200 a month, p99 latency 40 ms against 25 ms. Cites the source of each.
Notes that the Queue B numbers in queue-b.md are from 2023 and superseded, and does not use them.
Gives a clear recommendation that follows from the evidence and names the open question about global ordering.

checks.cmd: node -e 'const t=require("fs").readFileSync("out/brief.md","utf8");const A=new RegExp("recommend","gi"),R=[new RegExp("queue a|queue b|managed|self-run|option","i")],W=300;let ok=false;for(const m of t.matchAll(A)){const s=t.slice(Math.max(0,m.index-W),m.index+m[0].length+W);if(R.every(r=>r.test(s))){ok=true;break}}process.exit(ok?0:1)'

node -e 'const t=require("fs").readFileSync("out/brief.md","utf8");const A=new RegExp("80|1,?200","gi"),R=[new RegExp("cost|price|cheaper|month|expensive","i")],W=300;let ok=false;for(const m of t.matchAll(A)){const s=t.slice(Math.max(0,m.index-W),m.index+m[0].length+W);if(R.every(r=>r.test(s))){ok=true;break}}process.exit(ok?0:1)'

node -e 'const t=require("fs").readFileSync("out/brief.md","utf8");const A=new RegExp("2023|superseded|stale|outdated|old","gi"),R=[new RegExp("queue-b|queue b|latency|throughput|note","i")],W=300;let ok=false;for(const m of t.matchAll(A)){const s=t.slice(Math.max(0,m.index-W),m.index+m[0].length+W);if(R.every(r=>r.test(s))){ok=true;break}}process.exit(ok?0:1)'
